items: Subset doc: Not needed: CI-only change, no compiler or runtime behaviour changes

findings.title: Package-level repro drops the runner's `-skip` and `-timeout 2h`
findings.body: Rows without a test name rerun the whole package without `run_native_tests.py`'s `-skip TestParseCorpusFiles|…` and `-timeout 2h`. Measured: `go test -count=1 …/parser` prints 5289 `--- FAIL` lines from tests CI skips (with `-skip`, none run). Import `SKIP_PATTERN` and `TIMEOUT` from `run_native_tests` and add them.

findings.title: PR body doesn't follow the PR template
findings.body: `.github/pull_request_template.md` asks for Purpose (with `Fixes #N`, or a reason when there is no issue), Approach and the Checklist; the body uses Goals/Design/Tests sections instead and has no checklist. Please map it onto the template.
